# LeakSanitizer suppressions for phpser ASAN CI job.
#
# Format: one rule per line, "leak:<symbol-or-source-substring>".
# Suppressed allocations show up under the LSAN "matched suppressions"
# heading at process exit; new leaks still fail the run.
#
# Prefer narrow symbol-name suppressions over module-level "leak:libfoo"
# patterns — the latter mask real bugs the moment a vendored lib gains
# a new entry point.
#
# No suppressions currently. Add an entry only when you've audited the
# leak (e.g. process-lifetime allocations in php-src own code) and
# decided it's not actionable here.
